name: workerportal
notes: Lets a labourer log in on a phone and read only their own records. An admin links one login (a user holding the worker role) to one worker record; every /me/worker query takes the worker from that link, never from the request, and answers 403 to a login with no link or whose worker has left (access ends at the end of the left date). The worker sees their approved attendance by month (date, status, overtime hours; no money, project or team), their open advance balance with the advance recoveries of the last twelve approved wage sheets, and their own line of a wage sheet only while that sheet is approved. Nothing is written by the worker and no rate of any worker is shown. Linking a login that holds other roles besides worker needs the admin's confirmation; every link change is audited and emitted as workerportal.account.changed.
